description:
Format JavaScript, TypeScript or JSX with js-beautify, or minify JavaScript/TypeScript by removing comments and whitespace (no renaming, no rewriting; line breaks are kept where automatic semicolon insertion needs them). The output is re-lexed and compared token by token with the input.

Returns: Text: the formatted or minified code. structuredContent { code, mode, inputBytes, outputBytes, savedPercent, warnings[] }.
Example input: {"code":"function add(a,b){return a+b}","mode":"beautify","language":"javascript","indent":2,"brace_style":"collapse","keep_license":true}
On error, includes hint: Pass the whole file as `code`. An unterminated string, comment or regex is reported with its line and column.

brace_style.description: Brace placement when beautifying: collapse = K&R (same line), expand = Allman (own line).

code.description: Source code to format or minify.

indent.description: Spaces per indent level when beautifying (0 = tabs).

language.description: Language of the code. TypeScript gets generic and optional-marker fix-ups; JSX cannot be minified.

mode.description: beautify = pretty-print, minify = strip comments and whitespace.

name: js_beautify
title: JavaScript / TypeScript beautify or minify
